events.text: Phase I: autonomous self-test, N2 blanket pressure verified in GP-300 cells, BMS and motor-controller pre-ignition checks
Electric pumps at operational RPM, 28-engine Shakti cluster ignition
Liftoff, stack clear of pad; TVC gimbal loop active
Max-Q 37.7 kPa
MECO (FCU velocity threshold) at 55.2 km, 2083 m/s
Upper-stage guidance: burn 1 at 3 deg pitch, apogee cut-off at 550 km, coast, circularise
Stage separation: pneumatic latches released, break-wire confirmed; Vibhu vacuum engine start, star trackers in the GNC loop
Booster 180 deg flip on gaseous RCS complete; Shakti subset re-ignites (propellant settling monitored)
Divert burn complete (150 m/s, cut-off error +3.0 m/s); barge on station 491.9 km downrange (design touchdown point)
Drag fins open at 100 km: 4 panels on the base ring to 32 deg, drag area x2.05; fin encoders and FBG strain network logging
SECO-1: transfer orbit 125 x 579 km, coasting to apogee (162 kg propellant left)
Entry burn at 80 km, 1832 m/s
Entry burn complete (1001 m/s); aerodynamic descent, drag fins tracking the design trajectory (633 m off the reference)
Landing burn at 1.1 km, 165 m/s; radar + LiDAR altimeters take the vertical loop below 2 km

Booster landed on the barge, gear Hall-effect locks confirmed at 3.8 m/s, 3 m from the deck centre, 492 km downrange, prop remaining 300 kg; recovery dv used boostback 150, entry_burn 1001, landing_burn 303 m/s; peak 3.4 g, peak heating 58 kW/m2
Second burn at 607 km: circularisation
SECO-2: orbit 581 x 637 km, 118 kg propellant margin
Orbit insertion confirmed, LELP + upper stage nominal

Main parachute at 4 km, 26 m/s under the aeroshell; 15 m ringsail, reefed fill in 6 s
Splashdown at 8.1 m/s on the inflated aeroshell, which cushions the impact and floats the lab; Bay of Bengal, 2.6 km from the recovery ship
Whole lab and aeroshell craned aboard the recovery ship 24 min after splashdown; all 32 modules on board

Module 17 handed to the Zurich Biotech Lab courier aboard the recovery ship with its signed custody ledger (chain verified), 4 C air freight to Zurich; the other 31 modules go to their owners' couriers
Mission complete; booster assigned to flight 2; all 32 modules on their way to their owners
